controlProbe.scope: Trusted CDP Space events on the existing Resume/Pause display button after the real receipt body arrives. Event Timing durations are quantized and omit events below the browser threshold (minimum 16 ms); handler-to-animation-frame is not paint latency. Node round-trip includes protocol overhead. No physical-input latency claim. Raw timings can include later pointer interactions; receiptControlTimings selects only timestamp-matched keyboard events from the receipt probe. Input is dispatched after the controller receives the receipt, so this does not measure input already queued during an earlier stall.

frameIntervals.scope: External requestAnimationFrame intervals from native execution continuation through 500 ms after both verified canvas projection and post-receipt keyboard controls settle; variable-length 65-node window, not isolated preparation time or a 10k/50k graph benchmark
